source_clause: NEWPR9.1) Editing an existing Profile (from the Edit Profile screen) will return the user to the page of the “Edit Profile” tab they initiated the editing from.
leaf_desc_037: NEWPR9.1) Editing an existing Profile (from the Edit Profile screen) will return the user to the page of the “Edit Profile” tab they initiated the editing from.
reasoning: 驗證目標：8.10.1（NEWPR9.1）—— 自 Edit Profile 畫面發起之編輯，完成後回到發起之該頁。關鍵情境條件：發起頁須先記錄，否則「回到原頁」無對照。為什麼這樣切：本 leaf 為編輯路徑之回程。

tcs.tc_title: Editing returns to the originating Edit Profile page
tcs.test_item: Editing returns to the originating Edit Profile page
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Driver Profile A is the active Profile
2. The “Edit Profile” tab is open at the page holding the username option
3. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Record which page of the “Edit Profile” tab is open
2. Select the option to edit the username and complete the edit
3. Read the screen and check which page is shown
tcs.expected_result:
1. The page of the “Edit Profile” tab is recorded
2. The username edit is completed
3. The page recorded in step 1 is shown again
tcs.priority_basis: 自 Edit Profile 起始之編輯，其返回頁
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: **與 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-080` 之結果相反** —— 新增完成回 “All Profiles”，編輯完成回**發起編輯之該頁**；兩者同為「完成之後去哪」而條文分兩節，故各自成條。**ER3 以步驟 1 所記者為準而非寫死頁名** —— 條文說的是 `the page … they initiated the editing from`，寫死頁名等於把一個相對斷言改成絕對斷言。
